motion.name: shared-easing

motion.name: Press / Tap feedback — press
motion.purpose: Pointer press on filled/icon controls; disabled and focus-visible states excluded.

motion.name: Press / Tap feedback — release
motion.purpose: Interruptible transform return; absent with reduced motion.

motion.name: Origin-aware animation — enter
motion.purpose: Menu opens with opacity and discrete display/overlay retention.

motion.name: Origin-aware animation — exit
motion.purpose: Menu closes along the same path.

motion.name: reduced-motion-menu
motion.purpose: Menu transition without movement or scale.

motion.name: keyboard-response
motion.purpose: Keyboard menu, concept, and route actions are instant. Enter on the lettering clears transforms and changes finish immediately.

motion.name: Reveal
motion.purpose: Masked homepage headline entrance, no-preference only.

motion.name: Stagger
motion.purpose: Second hero line delay.

motion.name: hero-copy-entrance
motion.purpose: Coordinates supporting copy with the headline.

motion.name: hero-figure-entrance
motion.purpose: One entrance for the static brand image.

motion.name: Scroll-driven animation
motion.value: scrub: true; ease: none; start: top 45%; end: bottom 75%
motion.purpose: Desktop-only native-scroll stage at minimum 800px width and 650px height, without reduced motion. Setup and refreshInit fit the plane uniformly using sticky top, unscaled caption/margin, blur height, and 16px clearance. The 35rem natural plane at 800–1100px has its scaled height reserved by an outer frame. Compact, short, reduced-motion, and import-failure modes expose working local concepts instead of the stage. Cleanup removes refresh listeners and inline height/transform.

motion.name: service-concept-pose
motion.purpose: Resting dimensional pose for the first two concepts; the final web concept settles flat. Transform and opacity are reversible through scroll.

motion.name: Automation object motion
motion.purpose: Routes the inquiry and positions the prepared brief/keycaps.

motion.name: Automation field reveal
motion.purpose: Last desktop field completes at 270ms. Mobile omits the middle decorative field and uses a 45ms final delay, finishing at 225ms.

motion.name: SaaS perspective stack
motion.purpose: Customer/Team/Owner selection reorders cards; inactive bodies recede.

motion.name: Responsive web concept
motion.purpose: Desktop/Mobile selection shifts the browser and phone composition.

motion.name: Local concept reduced motion
motion.purpose: Retains state changes; keyboard activation disables transitions completely.

motion.name: Snippet action press
motion.purpose: Pointer press feedback on the 48px action; keyboard focus remains immediate.

motion.name: Footer letter spring
motion.purpose: A bounded requestAnimationFrame spring preserves each letter’s position and release velocity. It stops when settled; no idle loop.

motion.name: Footer gesture response
motion.value: resisted travel limit min(60px, 9% width); release velocity cap ±450px/s; tap impulse 420–620px/s
motion.purpose: Native button supports touch and pointer taps/drags with pointer capture and touch-action: pan-y. Enter/reduced-motion changes the finish instantly; visibility, intersection, resize, blur, preference, and unmount paths clean up.

motion.name: Route defocus/refocus
motion.purpose: Native React ViewTransition animates snapshots, preserving ordinary link/history/focus behavior. The overlay is pointer-transparent.

motion.name: Route preference alternative
motion.purpose: Reduced motion or reduced transparency removes snapshot blur. Keyboard navigation has no animation.

narrative.overview:
Zavino presents technology through the physical calm of an industrial design catalogue: forest-green ink, sage grounds, ivory objects, generous image fields, clear type, and open rows. Dimensional service concepts make capabilities tangible across desktop and mobile while real controls and explanations stay easy to use.

Preserve the Zavino name and symbol. The latest explicit user instruction replaces the earlier blue palette and static mobile service fallback with dark green, working mobile concepts, a playful lettering button, global progressive blur, and route defocus/refocus. The retained daylight catalogue now includes a miniature ivory fighter jet on a green ramp. The footer owns a deep forest field; the rest of the site remains light.
keyCharacteristics: Sage grounds group whole sections; linen adds a supporting material and the footer carries the darkest green.
Medium-weight Manrope headings pair with platform body text.
Broad imagery, ruled service chapters, and a bounded visual stage give content room to breathe.
Controls use small radii, clear boundaries, and visible focus.
Work and demonstrations retain explicit, truthful attribution.
Motion is tied to entrance, scroll progress, or direct input; mobile, keyboard, and reduced-motion alternatives preserve the interaction state.

rules.name: The Section Ground Rule
rules.body: Use sage and linen grounds to organize content; use forest ink for reading and actions, and reserve the darkest field for the signature.

rules.name: The Readable Entry Rule
rules.body: Editable text stays at the field size, and labels remain visible above the control.

rules.name: The Object Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve dimensional depth for physical imagery, floating dialogs, illustrative interface objects, and the footer signature; keep ordinary reading surfaces flat.

dos: Do use sage and linen grounds for grouping, forest ink for reading, and the dark forest field for the signature.
Do pair medium Manrope headings with readable platform body text.
Do preserve broad image fields, ruled service chapters, and the hierarchy between primary and supporting content.
Do preserve working mobile concepts, visible focus, explicit labels, immediate keyboard state changes, and preference-based alternatives.
Do distinguish owned products, delivered creative work, and illustrative concepts in nearby copy.
Do retain provenance when replacing or adding a shipping raster.
donts: Don't reintroduce the superseded blue palette or turn the catalogue into a dark dashboard; the dark signature is intentional.
Don't add decorative kickers or use nonsequential numbers as a house style.
Don't turn every service or content group into a raised card.
Don't intercept native scrolling or add continuous idle animation; the brand image remains a still.
Don't reduce editable text below the field token, reuse miniature text for controls, or animate keyboard focus.
Don't present concepts, simulated states, or brand imagery as delivered customer outcomes.
